script.base: Books expect a competitive high-scoring game, not a blowout: KC 27.0 implied, DET 24.5, spread only 2.5 so starter snaps should hold. Detroit mixes Gibbs (49/212 L3) and Montgomery (39/228 L3) with Goff to St. Brown (24 tgt, 247 yds L3); Kansas City splits Hunt (30/117) and Pacheco (24/116) and moves the chains through Kelce (20 tgt, 135 yds L3) while Thornton/Worthy/Brown take the air yards.
script.flip1: KC gets up early, Hunt and Pacheco grind (DET run D 4.13 YPC, but McNeill is out), Mahomes and Kelce late volume dies, and Detroit abandons the run so Gibbs/Montgomery rush lines die while St. Brown, LaPorta and Williams targets spike.
script.flip2: Detroit's two-back game controls the clock and holds the game under 51.5; KC throws from behind so Thornton (314 air yds L3) spikes and St. Brown stalls if Goff only needs ~25 passes. Unsaved October wind at Arrowhead is an extra under flip.

injury_fallout: Known from the pre-game nflverse report; inactives ~90 min pre-kick are not in the pack. DET loses LT Taylor Decker (Out, shoulder) and T Giovanni Manu (Out, knee), so pressure should rise, rush efficiency should fall, and quick throws to St. Brown and LaPorta should rise while Gibbs/Montgomery yards are at risk. DET CB Terrion Arnold (Out, shoulder) and CB Avonte Maddox (Out, hamstring) plus S Kerby Joseph (Q, knee) and S Brian Branch (Q, ankle) thin the coverage unit in front of Kelce, Brown and Thornton; DT Alim McNeill (Out, knee) and LB Zach Cunningham (Out, hamstring) soften the front seven. RB Sione Vaki (Out) does not change the Gibbs/Montgomery split. WR Kalif Raymond (Q, neck) would add targets to St. Brown/Williams/LaPorta only if inactive. KC T Josh Simmons (Q, personal) is the only Chiefs flag; if he sits, Mahomes pressure and KC rush efficiency get worse.

matchup.shell: MOFO/MOFC and man/zone rates are not in the pack. Usable shell proxy: KC blitz 37%, DET blitz 36%. DET EPA/dropback is 0.89 vs blitz vs 0.16 with no blitz, so KC pressure feeds Goff's quick game. KC EPA/dropback is 0.09 vs blitz vs 0.24 with none, so Detroit's blitz suppresses Mahomes.
matchup.pressure: Both teams blitz about 36-37%. Pressure helps Detroit's short/intermediate targets (St. Brown 24 tgt L3, LaPorta 14, Gibbs 10) and hurts KC's deep air-yard group (Thornton 314, Worthy 253, Brown 243) more than Kelce's short air (80). Decker and Manu out raise the chance DET's own protection fails before the blitz advantage shows up.
matchup.bleeds: KC allows 5.02 rush YPC and 18 runs of 10+, and pass YPA of 6.26 left (61 att), 6.75 middle (20), 7.42 right (65), with 13 gains of 20+ for 159 yards. DET allows 4.13 rush YPC and 16 runs of 10+, and pass YPA of 7.64 left (56), 10.21 middle (38), 5.14 right (64), with 16 gains of 20+ for 174 yards. Soft spots: Detroit's middle, KC's right side, and KC's run defense.
matchup.overlap: Cleanest overlap is Kelce, KC's top target (20 tgt / 135 yds / 80 air L3), into Detroit's middle at 10.21 YPA, with Arnold, Maddox and Cunningham out and both safeties questionable. Second overlap is St. Brown (24 tgt / 247 yds / 177 air L3) into a 37% KC blitz that Detroit has destroyed (0.89 EPA), plus KC's 7.42 YPA on the right.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because Arrowhead became a two-back grind: Montgomery and Gibbs kept Goff under 30 passes, Decker and Manu never gave the blitz-beating quick game time to breathe, and St. Brown posted another 70-77 instead of 100. On the other side Joseph and Branch both played, Detroit's 4.13 YPC run defense plus a KC lead let Hunt and Pacheco salt it, and Kelce's weeks 3-5 pace of 45 yards showed up again — the two 61s were the ceiling, the 26 was the repeatable floor once the middle was clouded, and 48.5 needed a spike the 27-point implied total never forced. The counter is strong enough to flag Kelce and keep St. Brown at lean, not strong enough to erase the middle-YPA and blitz-EPA overlaps.
slip_story: One story: competitive pass-volume game that lands near 51.5, not a clock-grind under and not a KC blowout. Stack Kelce recyds over 48.5 with St. Brown recyds over 77.5; they win together if both QBs throw. Do not add Gibbs or Montgomery rush overs (opposite script, and both Detroit tackles are out) or a total under. Thornton over is a conditional add only if Joseph and Branch are inactive later, and it is not on this slip. No TD legs, one market per player, two legs because no third name cleared the read.
